Vendored, self-contained browser ESM builds.

- pdf-lib 1.17.1 from the Codex bundled dependency runtime; MIT, license included.
- @pdf-lib/fontkit 1.1.1 from the official npm package; MIT, license and upstream README included. Published 2020-11-28; SHA-512 checked against official npm metadata before extraction. Source: https://github.com/Hopding/fontkit
- pako 1.0.11, required by fontkit 1.1.1; official npm archive verified against its SHA-512 integrity. MIT and Zlib licenses included. Bundled as local browser ESM to keep fontkit self-contained.
- Noto Sans uses the SIL Open Font License, included at public/fonts/OFL.txt. Source: https://github.com/notofonts/noto-fonts

No install scripts or replacement framework dependencies are required.
